clue.text: Small number approach, right to enter country

indicators.note: to enter says the letter for right goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: NO is the short form of number, a small way of writing it
a way is a road or approach to a place

explanation.surface: Someone small in number edges towards a country, with the right to enter it.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway is a Scandinavian nation, an example of a country.

clue.text: Subtle points of detail in good clothing

parts.note: nice means good or pleasant
ties are items of clothing worn round the neck

explanation.surface: Fine details matter in well-made clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Niceties are fine distinctions or small refinements of detail.

clue.text: Crude sketch of bird, we're told

indicators.note: we're told says the word is heard spoken

parts.note: a ruff is a wading bird

explanation.surface: A rough drawing of a bird, or so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough is a preliminary draft or outline drawing.

clue.text: Aluminium key, not new it's claimed

parts.note: Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

indicators.note: not new says the letter n, short for new, is left out

parts.note: the legend on a map is its key

explanation.surface: Someone says an aluminium key is not new.
explanation.definitionFit: Alleged means asserted without proof, something stated as claimed.

clue.text: Timely reminder

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means punctual or done on time
a cue given to someone who has forgotten their line

explanation.surface: A reminder that arrives at just the right moment.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word serves as an adjective for punctual and a noun for a cue to the memory.

clue.text: Snubs fans supporting Forest essentially

indicators.note: supporting says, in a down answer, the fans go below the other piece
essentially picks out the central heart of the word Forest

parts.note: buffs are enthusiasts or fans

explanation.surface: Supporters backing Nottingham Forest give the cold shoulder.
explanation.walkthrough: Forest is the football club Nottingham Forest. 'essentially' gives RE, its middle two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuff is to reject curtly, so rebuffs are snubs.

clue.text: Revolutionary, somewhat headstrong, is nominated as cleric

indicators.note: Revolutionary says the hidden letters are read backwards
somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A rather wilful revolutionary is put forward as a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: A monsignor is a Roman Catholic priest given an honorary title, a senior cleric.

clue.text: Kind of scout to give money in the past

definitions.meaning: a ... scout looks for gifted performers
a unit of weight and money in the ancient world

explanation.surface: A scout who gave money long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a scout for gifted people and an ancient coinage measure.

clue.text: Doubts prison officer holds back reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly says we hear the words rather than see them written

parts.note: screw is slang for a prison warder, and pulls means holds back, as a jockey restrains a horse

explanation.surface: A prison guard has misgivings and keeps something to himself.
explanation.walkthrough: SCREW + PULLS said quickly sounds like the answer. A screw is British prison slang for a warder.
explanation.definitionFit: Scruples are moral qualms or hesitations, a kind of doubt about acting.

clue.text: Tomb of Argos chap surprisingly just discovered

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters of Argos chap turn up in an unexpected order
discovered means the cover, the outer letters, is taken off just

explanation.surface: A tomb belonging to a man from Argos has only just been found.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' means uncovered here, leaving US from just.
explanation.definitionFit: A sarcophagus is a stone coffin, an ancient tomb.

clue.text: Cork licensee gutted finding gross mismanagement

parts.note: a bung is a stopper or cork

indicators.note: gutted means the inside of the word licensee is removed, keeping only its outer letters

explanation.surface: An Irish pub landlord in Cork, devastated, finds his business badly mishandled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cork' looks like the Irish city but is a stopper. 'gutted' leaves LE from licensee.
explanation.definitionFit: A bungle is a clumsy botch, a badly handled job.

clue.text: Desire of charming woman to go topless

indicators.note: to go topless says the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a witch casts charms, so is a charming woman in the magical sense

explanation.surface: A seductive woman longs to go topless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charming' means casting spells here, not attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: An itch is a restless longing or craving for something.

clue.text: Sweetheart having wild fling with rider

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of fling and rider are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: A lover is having a passionate affair with a horseman.
explanation.definitionFit: A girlfriend is a regular romantic partner, someone's sweetheart.

clue.text: Relative dunce is soon struggling over calculus primarily

indicators.note: struggling suggests the letters writhe about into a different arrangement
primarily picks out the first letter of calculus

explanation.surface: A slow-witted family member will soon be battling with calculus.
explanation.walkthrough: The C from 'calculus primarily' joins DUNCE IS SOON in the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A second cousin is a kinsman who shares great-grandparents with you.

clue.text: Group of musicians love star, Cher, performing

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O

indicators.note: performing suggests the letters of star and Cher are acting out a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A fan loves the star Cher on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra is a large ensemble of instrumental players.

clue.text: Daughter, extremely embarrassed, welcomes facial hair being removed

indicators.note: welcomes says the outer letters take the facial hair in between them
extremely picks the outermost letters of embarrassed

parts.note: tache is short for moustache

explanation.surface: A daughter, deeply embarrassed, lets her moustache be taken off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'welcomes' puts TACHE between the E and D of embarrassed.
explanation.definitionFit: Detached means separated or taken off, so it matches removed.

clue.text: Impetuous writer in car lacking a vehicle safety feature?

indicators.note: in says the impetuous writer goes inside what is left of car
lacking says the letter a is removed from car

parts.note: taken as written
rash means impetuous or hasty
J. M. Barrie is the Scottish author of Peter Pan

explanation.surface: A hot-headed author in a car with no safety equipment, reckless driving.
explanation.walkthrough: The writer is J. M. Barrie of Peter Pan fame; 'lacking a' leaves CR, which 'in' splits open.
explanation.definitionFit: A crash barrier is a roadside fence that stops vehicles leaving the road, a safety device.

clue.text: African diary grandmother keeps up

indicators.note: up, in a down answer, says the letters are read from the bottom upwards
keeps says the grandmother holds the diary inside her

parts.note: nana is a familiar word for a grandmother
a log is a daily record or diary

explanation.surface: A grandmother hangs on to a diary from Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeps' makes NALOGNA, and 'up' reads it bottom to top in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Angolan describes someone or something from Angola, an African country.

clue.text: Warning after mad bid's oddly abandoned for corporation

indicators.note: after says the warning comes behind the other piece
oddly abandoned says the odd-placed letters of mad bid's are thrown away, keeping the even ones

parts.note: an omen is a warning sign

explanation.surface: A warning comes after a crazy takeover bid is dropped by a firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corporation' is an old jokey word for a pot belly, not a company.
explanation.definitionFit: Corporation is a humorous dated term for a large belly, hence the stomach area.

clue.text: Refusing to reveal heavy defeat

explanation.surface: Keeping quiet about a heavy loss.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means concealing something and also a severe beating in a contest.

clue.text: Unattached princess's telephone line is busy?

parts.note: Di, Princess Diana, with the possessive gives DIS
a busy telephone line is said to be engaged

explanation.surface: A single princess finds her phone line always busy.
explanation.walkthrough: ENGAGED, which can mean betrothed, sits beside a definition meaning free.
explanation.definitionFit: Disengaged means detached or not involved, free of connections.

clue.text: Boozy type of party animal

definitions.meaning: a ... party is a groom's drinking night before his wedding

explanation.surface: A drunken kind of party animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a pre-wedding men's night out and an adult male deer.

clue.text: Fashionable sorts of electric vehicles on the rise

indicators.note: on the rise, in a down answer, says the word is read upwards

parts.note: trams are electric street vehicles running on rails

explanation.surface: Electric cars are trendy and becoming more popular.
explanation.definitionFit: Smart means stylish or chic, the same as fashionable.

clue.text: Weapon, prototype initially, one many rejected

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of prototype

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: rejected says the word for many is turned back on itself

parts.note: lots means many

explanation.surface: A prototype firearm was turned down by many people.
explanation.definitionFit: A pistol is a small handgun, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Doctor hasty to claim unknown politician shows compassion

indicators.note: to claim means the jumbled letters take hold of the other pieces inside them
to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters of hasty are altered

parts.note: Y is one of the letters used for an unknown in algebra
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A rushed physician admits a nameless MP and shows kindness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a physician but is the anagram signal, making SATHY, which 'to claim' opens after its S.
explanation.definitionFit: Sympathy is feeling for another's suffering, the same as compassion.

clue.text: Today's setter, awfully angry about having poor definition?

indicators.note: about says the scrambled letters go round the setter
awfully suggests the letters of angry are badly mangled into a new order

parts.note: the setter refers to himself as I

explanation.surface: The setter is terribly cross about something poorly defined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'definition' here is image sharpness, not a clue's definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A grainy photo or film is blurred by visible grain, lacking sharpness.

clue.text: Time to interrupt college education in Leeds perhaps

indicators.note: to interrupt says the letter for time breaks into the other pieces

parts.note: uni is short for university, a college

explanation.surface: Taking time out to break off college studies in Leeds.
explanation.walkthrough: Leeds United is a football club in the English city of Leeds, so the answer follows 'Leeds' in its name.
explanation.definitionFit: The word completes the football club name Leeds United, one of several such clubs.
